hero.answer: Claude cannot reach a REG.RU mailbox on its own. MCPEmails is a hosted MCP server that connects it over IMAP at mail.hosting.reg.ru on port 993, signing in with the full address and the mailbox password, so Claude, Cursor or any MCP client can read, search, send and organize the mail. REG.RU's help names mail.hosting.reg.ru as the server for both directions on an encrypted connection, with 993 for IMAP and 465 for SMTP, and the full address as the login. This page covers mailboxes on REG.RU hosting, created in ispmanager, cPanel or Plesk; REG.RU's other mail products have their own hosts. One inbox is free, forever.

method.title: How REG.RU connects: mail.hosting.reg.ru on 993 and 465
method.body: REG.RU's mail-client page gives one name for encrypted connections to a mailbox on its hosting: mail.hosting.reg.ru, as the incoming and the outgoing server. Its port table lists 993 for IMAP and 465 for SMTP with SSL/TLS, and 143 and 587 for unencrypted use; the page adds, in its Thunderbird and The Bat! sections, that the encrypted setup is available on Linux hosting. The login is the full address, name@ваш.домен in REG.RU's own notation, with the mailbox password set in the panel. The host answered a live TLS connection with a certificate for *.hosting.reg.ru over TLS 1.2, a short IMAP4 ready banner that advertises UIDPLUS, IDLE and QUOTA, and an SMTP greeting with PLAIN and LOGIN and a 50 MB message limit. The IMAP server does not advertise SASL-IR, which MCPEmails handles with the two-step authentication exchange. The mailbox itself is created in the hosting panel: in ispmanager under Почта, Создать ящик, after the mail domain exists under Почтовые домены.

setup.p: Sign up at mcpemails.com. The free plan connects one mailbox, forever, and does not ask for a card.

setup.h: Create or find the mailbox in the hosting panel
setup.p: In ispmanager, open Почта. The domain must first exist under Почтовые домены; then Создать ящик asks for the name before the @, the domain and a password. In cPanel the same lives under Почта, Почтовые учетные записи, and in Plesk under Почта, Создать адрес электронной почты. REG.RU says a new mailbox is live within an hour. The password you set there is the one IMAP checks.

setup.h: Enter the address and the password in MCPEmails
setup.p: Choose IMAP / SMTP and enter the full address, such as info@your.domain, with the mailbox password. For a .рф domain, enter the domain part as Punycode, as REG.RU's own iOS instructions do. The host mail.hosting.reg.ru is prefilled for both directions, with 993 and SSL for IMAP and 465 and SSL for SMTP, and was verified from a live TLS connection.

setup.h: Paste the MCP URL into your AI
setup.p: Drop https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT, authorize, and your agent has the mailbox.

gotchas.h: Hosting mail only: Яндекс 360 and other REG.RU mail products use other hosts
gotchas.p: REG.RU resells several mail services, and its own help page sends Mail.ru addresses to imap.mail.ru and Yandex addresses to imap.yandex.ru, each with that provider's app password or access switch. mail.hosting.reg.ru is for a mailbox created inside your hosting panel. If your domain's mail runs on Яндекс 360 or another service you ordered through REG.RU, follow that provider's page instead; the host here will refuse the login.

gotchas.h: A 36-process ceiling on shared hosting, and IMAP connections count
gotchas.p: REG.RU's troubleshooting page explains that shared hosting allows no more than 36 simultaneously running processes, and that each open IMAP connection is one of them. Several mail programs on several devices can reach the ceiling, after which mail and the website on the same account behave unstably. REG.RU's advice is to limit each client to one cached connection. MCPEmails opens a connection per request and closes it, rather than keeping several idle, so it adds little to the count; if you hit the limit, the programs holding connections open are the ones to trim.

gotchas.h: Sending is capped per day and per message
gotchas.p: REG.RU's hosting mail page sets the limits: 3,000 messages per 24 hours on ordinary hosting and 9,000 on VIP plans, no more than 150 recipients in one message, a 50 MB maximum message size, and 10 messages a day on a trial. The daily limit covers the whole hosting account, mail sent by scripts included, and sending resumes the next day. A trial account is not a place to test an agent that sends.

limits: The SMTP server announces a maximum message size of 50 MB, which matches REG.RU's stated limit. A forward carrying larger attachments is refused at send time.
Because the server does not advertise MOVE, a move is not atomic. If a connection drops mid-operation a message can briefly exist in both folders.
The server negotiates TLS 1.2, not 1.3. That is still a modern, verified connection; it only means the handshake looks older than most hosts on this site.

faq.q: Does Claude work with email on REG.RU hosting?
faq.a: Not on its own. Claude has no built-in REG.RU connector. Pointing an MCP server such as MCPEmails at the mailbox over IMAP gives Claude read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize access to it, and the same connection then works from Cursor, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.

faq.q: What are the REG.RU IMAP and SMTP settings?
faq.a: For a mailbox on REG.RU hosting, IMAP is mail.hosting.reg.ru on port 993 with SSL/TLS and SMTP is mail.hosting.reg.ru on port 465 with SSL/TLS, with authentication required. The username is your full address and the password is the mailbox password. The host was confirmed from a live TLS connection on the date shown on this page.

faq.q: Why is my REG.RU mailbox password rejected?
faq.a: Check three things: that the mailbox exists in the hosting panel and is not on another REG.RU mail product such as Яндекс 360, that the username is the complete address with a Punycode domain for .рф, and that the password is the one set on the mailbox in ispmanager, cPanel or Plesk rather than your REG.RU account password.

faq.q: Does REG.RU need an app password?
faq.a: No, not for mail on its hosting. The mailbox password authenticates both IMAP and SMTP. App passwords come up on REG.RU's help page only for Mail.ru and Yandex mailboxes, which are different services.

faq.q: Is my REG.RU mail stored on your servers?
faq.a: No. Messages are fetched live from REG.RU over IMAP for each request and handed to your AI client. Credentials are encrypted at rest and message bodies are not retained.
